guidelines.detail: refines ACT-07 (The description lists paperwork, orientation, and training as onboarding activities and says the process concludes after all onboarding steps are completed. The reference has a parallel gateway to coordinate these activities, but the generated model has no counterpart. This guideline makes the synchronization case in ACT-07 more specific; no learned guideline already covers it.)

refines FID-01 (The description establishes a start, ordered activities, and a transition into onboarding. The records show omitted activities or connections for those described steps. FID-01 already requires modeling every distinct stated activity, and this guideline refines that principle by making explicit that the described order and transitions must also be preserved.)

documentation rule FID-03 not applied (The training and orientation label pairs use different action verbs, supporting the need for labels faithful to the described actions. FID-03 already advises short, faithful activity labels and meaningful outcome labels, so this guideline is already covered.)

same as LRN-004 (The description states a transition into onboarding after offer acceptance, as well as the initial start and ordered work. The records show a missing onboarding activity and flow, plus missing flows connecting the start and initial activities. LRN-004 already covers modeling stated starts, activities, and sequence flows in order.)

same as LRN-001 (The description says selected candidates are invited, while the generated label says they are selected, changing the action being modeled (P5, S4). The other label pairs also illustrate the need to preserve described actions and outcomes. This is essentially the same guidance as LRN-001.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies multiple required activities within a phase, requires all of them before that phase can end, and specifies no order among them: Model the activities as parallel branches synchronized by a parallel gateway.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies multiple required activities within a phase, requires all of them before that phase can end, and specifies no order among them

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes different actions or process states involving the same participant or subject at different stages: Label each BPMN activity and outcome to reflect the specific action or state described at that stage; do not substitute a different action or an unsupported outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or outcome at a particular stage of the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a process start and an ordered sequence of activities or transitions between phases: Model the stated start, include each distinct activity, and connect the flow nodes with sequence flows in the described order, including transitions between phases.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a process start and an ordered sequence of activities or transitions between phases

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or a resulting process state in terms that distinguish it from other actions or outcomes
